_comment: Golden-output manifest for the recorded-format regression matrix (see formatMatrix.test.ts). Each entry pairs a checked-in fixture with the exact values the parser must produce for it. ONLY real recordings (scrubbed with scripts/redact-claude-recording.js) belong here; never a hand-written fixture. Hand-written fixtures live under synthetic/ with their own manifest and test. To extend to another editor's parser, add a sibling top-level key here plus a matching adapter in formatMatrix.test.ts's ADAPTERS map. Claude costs are priced with the test's mocked table (3 / 15 / 0.3 USD per million), not a real price list; Aider costs are the ones Aider itself wrote into the log (token counts came from a mock model endpoint, see the fixture README).

claude.description: scrubbed excerpt of a real Claude Code 2.1.291 session on Linux: nested message format, usage repeated per content-block line (deduped by message.id + requestId), 1h cache writes, Bash/Grep tool calls, one subagent file

aider.description: scrubbed analytics log written by real Aider 0.86.2 (aider-chat on Python 3.12, Linux) against a mock OpenAI-compatible endpoint: four launches (three stdin-driven, one --message; one of them failed before any message_send), 5 message_send events with usage, model names openai/REDACTED and openai/gpt-4o-mini, plus the string None on a non-usage event. Token counts of the streamed launch are Aider's own estimates, the rest are the mock's fixed counts
